item.title: Kenya’s capital markets regulator clears Nedbank’s NCBA partial takeover plan
item.description: Nedbank Group has secured a Kenyan regulatory waiver that clears the way for its plan to acquire about 66% of NCBA Group, one of East Africa’s biggest lenders.

item.title: Development capital financed Africa’s venture boom. It’s now slowing.
item.description: Africa’s venture capital fundraising fell for the first time in four years as Africa-focused fund managers raised only $107 million across final closes in six funds in 2025.

item.title: At tech events like ATS 2026, applause is easy, but real work is not
item.description: Now in its eighth edition, ATS is usually held in February, when the Nairobi skies are bright, activities are agog, and traffic is a bit brutal.

item.title: Terra partners Nigeria’s military-run defence firm on local production
item.description: Terra Industries, a Nigerian defence-technology startup has entered an agreement with DICON to localise the production of advanced security systems.

item.title: What you need to know before you buy the Google Pixel 10a
item.description: The Pixel 10a, is a step down from the 10th generation released last year, both for your wallet and in the features it presents.

item.title: Kenya’s BasiGo enters fixed-route commuting once targeted by Swvl
item.description: BasiGo, a Kenyan electric bus startup, is testing Jenga buses, a scheduled commuter service in Nairobi, the country’s capital, adding a new product line alongside its core electric vehicle supply business.

item.title: After MTN’s IHS deal, Africa’s tower market may no longer be neutral ground
item.description: With the IHS deal, MTN is reclaiming strategic control over assets it once sold and reshaping the economics of telecom infrastructure across its markets.

item.title: LoftyInc backs Moroccan fintech WafR’s $4 million seed round in North Africa push
item.description: LoftyInc Capital has co-led a seed round in Moroccan fintech startup WafR, marking the first investment from its newly launched Alpha Fund.

item.title: A new index wants to prepare African startups for London IPOs
item.description: The search for exit pathways in African tech has now set eyes on London's Stock Exchange after a decade of billions of dollars invested.
